desc: Derive the walk/moment closed form and edge cases (p=2 all-ones, p=3 reverse-edge, zero-diagonal row/column, global (-1)^K).
Implement the complete Python solution: p==1 zeros, p==2 N%2, p>2 compute A^p mod p, add zero-diagonal and p==3 off-diagonal corrections, apply global (-1)^K.
Verify with public samples (all 3 passed) and confirm edge-case handling.
Confirm O(N^3 log p) implementation with zero-skip and a==1/p-1 special cases is sufficient for N<=100.
